# Shared global app-kit routing block

Verified copy, 2026-09-21, of the app-kit block in the owner's global Claude Code
and Codex instruction files. This document is not loaded automatically. The
historical long UI-stack section was replaced because its blanket palette rewrite
and runtime prescriptions conflicted with current intent. Git retains that history.
Host configuration and verification: [agent setup](agent-setup.md).

This is a short reminder, not a second architectural policy. Before copying to
another workstation, select its local fallback path and preserve unrelated guidance.
Compare only the marked blocks; other global instructions legitimately differ.

<!-- appkit:begin -->
## App-kit adoption (UI/UX and CLI work)

Before material UI/UX or CLI work, read the project's intent and existing
docs/app-kit.md/appkit.adoption.json when present. Use the unified `appkit` MCP:
`get_kit_guidance` → `get_kit_decision("intent")`, then retrieve only routed docs.
Discover compatible first-party contracts with `search_capabilities`/`get_capability`;
select complete visual references separately via `search_design_assets` or
`search_components` (explicit source: tailwindplus or matdash), then exact get.
Inspect `list_quality_work`/`get_quality_work` before reuse; authored status and
successful retrieval are not runtime, visual, accessibility or performance proof.
Preserve reference hierarchy, typography, spacing and states. Never blindly replace
palette classes or strip dark variants. Choose themes/runtime/layers with the app;
do not force a Go migration, install dependencies or update pins implicitly.
Verify the actual task, keyboard/narrow/error states and CSS integration. At handoff,
use `get_kit_decision("contribution-loop")` to return reusable fixes/tests or record
a reasoned divergence. Keep project adoption and intent/agent routing current.
If MCP is unavailable, disclose it; use the selected pinned local docs or the
maintainer checkout at /Volumes/m2ext/code/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/docs/intent/README.md.
The legacy `tailwindplus` server is optional source-only fallback, not kit guidance.
<!-- appkit:end -->
